description: Wallet-address sanctions screening: exact-match verdict from our self-hosted OFAC-SDN oracle plus additive entity-name matching across open sanctions lists. Fail-closed — returns verdict "unscreened" (isSanctioned null) when no layer answered, never a fabricated clean. Params: address (required), entity (optional name hint), chain (optional echo). Informational only — not compliance advice. Free with X-ORKID-API-Key or $0.05 USDC/call via x402.

address.description: Wallet address to screen (hex, base58, bech32, tron formats)

chain.description: Optional chain hint echoed in the result

entity.description: Optional entity name for open-list name matching
